method: Model review of newly eligible Spain senses and inherited exclusions. Not human/native certification or a Spain-specific frequency study.
policy: Keep inherited grammar, homograph, commonness and suitability exclusions, except COGER whose coarse Mexico reading does not make its ordinary Spain grasp/take sense unsuitable. The explicit new exclusions below prevent spelling frequency for another reading from qualifying a marginal sense.

COCHE.reason: Use the Spain-labelled motor vehicle meaning before the historical carriage meaning.

PISO.reason: Show the ordinary Spain apartment meaning before the action of stepping.

MÓVIL.reason: Prefer the ordinary mobile telephone noun for this regional pack.

PATATA.reason: Prefer the edible potato tuber to the long botanical description.

CHINA.reason: Independent ordinary small-stone noun, not the country name or feminine agreement form.

COGER.reason: Ordinary neutral Spain infinitive meaning to take or grasp, explicitly source-labelled Spain.

VALE.reason: Independent assent interjection, not the conjugation of valer.

excluded.FLASH: The retained Spain sense is a specific frozen treat; spelling frequency also reflects the photographic loanword and does not establish that retained sense as common.
excluded.SALIDO: The only qualifying independent Spain sense is sexually charged; keep it guess-only under the inherited conservative suitability approach.
excluded.TUS: Spelling frequency reflects the possessive plural, not the retained uncommon dog-calling interjection. Keep it guess-only.
